title: Personal Training Packages: assigned trainer qualification level and specialty session terms by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states, for every tier, the qualification level of the trainer assigned to that tier's sessions, the extra fee charged for a specialty session beyond the base package price, which session types the tier's sessions may be booked as, and the fee to upgrade the assigned trainer's qualification level mid-package.

## Tier reference table

| Tier | Assigned trainer qualification level | Specialty session surcharge (USD) | Session types the tier allows | Trainer tier upgrade fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Single Session Pack | Certified | 0.00 | Standard only | 20.00 |
| 5-Session Starter Pack | Certified | 0.00 | Standard only | 20.00 |
| 10-Session Value Pack | Certified | 0.00 | Standard only | 20.00 |
| 20-Session Performance Pack | Senior | 0.00 | Standard only | 15.00 |
| Unlimited Monthly Coaching | Certified | 0.00 | Standard only | 25.00 |
| Elite Specialty Coaching | Specialty | 0.00 | Any (standard, nutrition-focused, or rehabilitation-focused) | 0.00 |

## Points of reference
Only Elite Specialty Coaching allows its sessions to be booked as any of the three session types Personal Training Packages defines, including the two specialty session types; every other tier restricts its sessions to the standard session type. None of the six tiers currently lists a nonzero specialty session surcharge. Elite Specialty Coaching, whose trainers are already at the specialty qualification level, is the only tier with no fee to upgrade the assigned trainer's tier, since there is no higher tier to upgrade to; every other tier charges a trainer-tier upgrade fee ranging from 15.00 to 25.00 dollars.
